assertions: Invalid account details are rejected synchronously with stable product codes before any repository mutation.
Valid display name, neighborhood, country prefix and local phone are compatibility-normalized once in the shared runtime.
Repeated Save while a mutation is active is suppressed before another coroutine or repository call is created.
Only SQLSTATE 23505 tied to an expected phone identity constraint maps to the stable collision result; unrelated HTTP 409 and unrelated unique failures retain their cause.
Canonical uniqueness is country_code plus phone_local and phone_e164; the same local number remains valid in another country.
The four obsolete global local-number indexes are absent and both canonical indexes are valid.
The production probes exercised acceptance and rejection inside an outer rollback and left zero residue.
limits: No complete native UI matrix was repeated solely for this Product SHA; affected focused tests and Android, Web/Wasm and iOS compilation were repeated.
The probe does not emit or retain profile identifiers, phone values, emails, credentials, connection strings, backup keys or private host paths.
This unit does not promote ACCOUNT-RECOVERY-SECRET, ACCOUNT-PASSWORD-LEGACY, avatar, SOS, logout, account deletion or any other Account/Profile subflow.
